doc.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Playing piano behind Madonna's brother and in Cambria
summary: A trio gig where he played piano, and a Cambria gig where audiences applauded his piano solos.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I’ve got it covered. In fact I played behind Madonna’s brother I think, piano, recently on a gig, a trio.
No kidding. What does Madonna’s brother do?
Well you know I’m not really sure except he hasn’t announced it too much but someone told me, the guy that used to run Pasquale’s out here, Pat Senatore, the bass player—
No, but is he a singer or something?
He sings, yeah. I don’t know if it’s professionally or what but he got a gig and I understand he says, “Oh that’s Madonna’s brother, Joey Ciccone.”
Oh yeah that last name rings a bell, that’s right.

Yeah so that might be him anyhow. I don’t know whether he announces it. Anyhow I got a call to play piano with the bass player and the drummer, and it came out fairly good and people were really applauding for the piano. So I said hey this is nice. We had one of those, a nice keyboard a Roland RD 300. It sounded good with the amplification.
So someone saw you that night, they think that you’re a piano player. © Fillius Jazz Archive -20-
And the next time they’ll see you and you’ll just be playing flute.

Hey this guy’s versatile. I played in Cambria with Charlie Shumack, there’s a club up there, so I was up there playing tenor with him and a few other people, I think my brother up there but he played vibes and I get on the piano for some things and the people were applauding when I played the solos, so I says hey I must be doing pretty good.

Anyhow this is my little thing. I don’t know whether we missed anything but that’s just a little idea of Sam Most and what is it, in 1999, really. I probably missed a few things but is there anything that you think might be interesting that I haven’t touched on before we close it?
